title: Why we have seasons
info: Earth's axis is tilted about 23.5 degrees.
When a hemisphere leans toward the Sun, that hemisphere has summer. Sunlight hits it more directly and days are longer.
Seasons are not caused by Earth being much closer to the Sun in summer. Earth is actually closest to the Sun in early January.

options: the Moon blocks the Sun each season
Earth's orbit is a perfect square
